instruction: Add a note "PROD" into the slide and give the slide a red background color.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding note 'PROD' and setting background to red RGB(255, 0, 0). Evaluator checks both with partial credit (0.5 for note, 0.5 for color).

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Both instruction requirements (note text and background color) are verified
Correct getter logic: Extracts note text from slide.notes_slide and background color from slide.background.fill, handles both solid fill and master background inheritance
Correct metric comparison: Case-sensitive note comparison matches task hint, exact RGB color matching is appropriate for red color verification
Proper partial credit: 50% weight for note match, 50% for color match aligns with scoring_breakdown metadata
Correct expected parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('note') and expected.get('bg_color') directly (not expected.get('rules'))
Appropriate postconfig: Saves file with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring changes are persisted to .pptx file
Edge case handling: Getter handles empty presentations and missing background fill gracefully
